categories.name: Smart Catch Supported
categories.description: Fish species that our AI can instantly identify.

fishes.name: Gilt-Head Bream
fishes.description: A fish of the bream family Sparidae found in the Mediterranean Sea and the eastern coastal regions of the North Atlantic Ocean.

fishes.name: Red Sea Bream
fishes.description: A fish of high economic value, prized for its flavor in Japan and other parts of Asia.
fishes.nutritional_info: High in Vitamin B12 and Selenium.

fishes.name: Sea Bass
fishes.description: A primarily ocean-going fish native to the waters off Europe's western and southern and Africa's northern coasts.
fishes.nutritional_info: Low in fat, high in protein.

fishes.name: Red Mullet
fishes.description: A species of goatfish found in the Mediterranean Sea, Marmara Sea, and Black Sea.
fishes.nutritional_info: Good source of Iodine and Iron.

fishes.name: Horse Mackerel
fishes.description: A species of jack mackerel in the family Carangidae.

fishes.name: Black Sea Sprat
fishes.description: A small herring-like fish found in the Black Sea and Sea of Azov.

fishes.name: Striped Red Mullet
fishes.description: A species of goatfish found in the Mediterranean Sea, eastern North Atlantic Ocean, and the Black Sea.

fishes.name: Trout
fishes.description: Freshwater fish belonging to the Salmonidae family. Popular for sport fishing and food.
fishes.nutritional_info: Excellent source of protein and niacin.

fishes.name: Shrimp
fishes.description: Decapod crustaceans with elongated bodies and a primarily swimming mode of locomotion.
fishes.nutritional_info: High in protein, low in calories.

categories.name: Marine Fish (Sea Fish)
categories.description: Saltwater fishes found in the coastal regions of India.

fishes.name: Pomfret (Paplet)
fishes.description: One of the most popular sea fishes in India. It has a flat body and a single bone, making it easy to eat. It is rich in protein and omega-3 fatty acids.
fishes.nutritional_info: High in Protein, Omega-3, Vitamin A, B12, and D.

fishes.name: Kingfish (Surmai)
fishes.description: Known as the King of the Indian Ocean. It is a delicacy in South and Western India. It has a distinct flavor and firm texture.
fishes.nutritional_info: Rich in Protein, Omega-3, and Vitamins.

fishes.name: Indian Mackerel (Bangda)
fishes.description: A very common and affordable fish found on the Indian coast. It is oily and has a strong flavor, often used in curries and fries.
fishes.nutritional_info: Excellent source of Omega-3 fatty acids and Selenium.

fishes.name: Bombay Duck (Bombil)
fishes.description: Despite its name, it is a fish. It has a very soft, gelatinous texture and is often eaten fried or dried.
fishes.nutritional_info: High in protein and calcium (when dried).

categories.name: Freshwater Fish
categories.description: Fishes found in rivers, lakes, and ponds across India.

fishes.name: Rohu (Rui)
fishes.description: A species of carp found in rivers in South Asia. It is a large omnivore and extensively used in aquaculture.
fishes.nutritional_info: Rich in Vitamin C and Omega-3 fatty acids.

fishes.name: Catla (Bhakur)
fishes.description: Also known as the major South Asian carp. It is an economically important South Asian freshwater fish in the carp family.
fishes.nutritional_info: Low in saturated fat, high in protein.

fishes.name: Hilsa (Ilish)
fishes.description: The national fish of Bangladesh and very popular in West Bengal, India. It is an anadromous fish (migrates from sea to river to spawn).
fishes.nutritional_info: Very high in Omega-3 fatty acids.

categories.name: Shellfish
categories.description: Crustaceans and mollusks popular in Indian cuisine.

fishes.name: Prawns (Jhinga)
fishes.description: Prawns are a common name for small aquatic crustaceans with an exoskeleton and ten legs. Widely used in curries and biryanis.
fishes.nutritional_info: High in protein, low in fat, rich in Zinc and Vitamin E.

fishes.name: Mud Crab (Kekda)
fishes.description: Found in estuaries and mangroves. Known for its sweet, tender meat.
fishes.nutritional_info: Rich in Omega-3, Selenium, and Riboflavin.
